events.title: Project teams
events.note: Both schools form their project teams and plan the year. Set up a quick contact channel between the teachers.

events.title: Class visits
events.note: The LTEtt team presents the project in all 5e classes.

events.title: Application deadline
events.note: Tuesday 17 November 2026: last day for LTEtt students to apply. Each school then selects its group of about 8 students.

events.title: Virtual meetings and language tandems
events.note: Online meetings between the two groups and language tandems (Portuguese, French, German, English), at least six sessions per student. Students get to know each other before the visits and learn about EU cohesion policy. A short starting survey measures where everyone stands.

events.title: Weekly project work (Wednesdays)
events.note: At LTEtt the project is an extracurricular activity every Wednesday at lunchtime, starting Wednesday 18 November 2026. Students work on the three modules: multilingualism and careers, island vs. continent, sustainability and solidarity.

events.title: Terceira → Ettelbruck
events.note: Saturday 27 February to Saturday 6 March 2027. About 8 students and 2 teachers from the Azores stay with host families in Luxembourg. Includes a day at the European Parliament in Brussels.

events.title: Ettelbruck → Terceira
events.note: About 8 students and their teachers from LTEtt stay with host families on Terceira. The exact days are still to be confirmed by both schools.

events.title: Evaluation and results
events.note: Final survey and evaluation. The students present their results: project portfolio, a multilingual guide, a digital exhibition and events at both schools.
